physical_subject: How can we narrow a root without solving a cubic?
relationship: Bisection preserves a root under continuity and opposite endpoint signs; width halves per iteration. Discontinuity invalidates the guarantee.
operation: A highlighted sign-changing interval halves around a continuous cubic; a jump supplies the failure case.
closest_prior: Earlier square-root integer recurrence and gradient descent
substantive_difference: Certified bracketing by continuity for cube root two; no recurrence approximation or derivative-based optimizer.
